title: Uniqueness of the Classical Langton Ant Highway from Its Layer Profile
description: Thin-wake rigidity derives the standard layer profile and all longitudinal residues from full drift (2,-2), growth twelve, width ten and at most one odd class on each interior level. General non-axis wake budgets and inverse synthesis remain. A mixed-wake interleaving parity identity gives an arbitrary-width necessary screen at full drift (2,-2); attributed periodic-growth dependencies and the separate profile-classification replay are retained.
